messages.subject: Multiple models in one compilation
parts:
Hello,

I have a data set of M features and N observations where I'd like to fit a separate zero-inflated negative binomial model for each feature of the data independently.  In rstan, this would involve adding several loops to fit M rows of data, with a normal distribution for example:

data { 
    int M; 
    int N[M]; 
    real y[M,N]; 
  } 
  parameters { 
    real mu[M]; 
  } 
  model { 
    for (m in 1:M) 
      y[m] ~ normal(mu[m], 1); 
  }

Is there a way to specify something equivalent to this in a call to brm to avoid compiling for every fit?

Thanks,

Steven

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Multiple models in one compilation
parts: This is not possible in brms, but you may use the update method to fit these models one after the other without recompiling each of them.
